company_name: Suzhou Betpak New Material Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Suzhou Betpak specializes in moisture-proof and anti-static packaging solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing and handling.
summary: Suzhou Betpak New Material Technology Co., Ltd provides specialized moisture-proof and rust-proof packaging solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include moisture barrier bags, shielding bags, and humidity indicator cards, all manufactured under strict quality controls to meet industry standards.

regional_presence.China: The company operates a manufacturing facility in Wujiang, Suzhou, which was established after relocating from Shanghai.
